name: Coin maker simulator
storyline: You used to manage the royal treasury. Now you’re part of it. The King locked you in the dungeon with no way out. You need to earn the trust by doing the job the king is 'asking' you to do. Making coins is your only way to freedom! Good news is, it seems like you have a talent for it and you ready to spend some time in this cosy place.
summary:
Coin Maker Simulator is a cozy first-person crafting and management game set in a colorful medieval world.

Coin Maker Simulator combines crafting, management, resource progression, physics-based interactions, and workshop customization into a relaxing sandbox experience.
